EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge.

Imperium - Adeptus Custodes.name: Gravimetric Grenade
Imperium - Adeptus Custodes.description:
WHEN: Start of your opponent's Charge phase.
TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit and one enemy unit visible to it within 12".
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for that enemy unit.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Armour of Contempt
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting phase or Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
EFFECT: Until the attacking unit finishes its attacks, worsen AP of attacks targeting your unit by 1.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: A Worthy Death
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: For each model destroyed before your unit fights, roll a D6. On a 4+, keep it in play until its unit fights or the phase ends; then remove it.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Might of Angels
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, its melee attacks have [LANCE].

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Adaptive Strategy
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
EFFECT: Select a Combat Doctrine; it is active for that unit until your next Command phase.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Storm of Devastation
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Until end of phase its ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Responsive Tactics
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Movement phase, after enemy ends a move within 8" of an unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move up to D6".

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Armour of Contempt
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, when enemy targets ADEPTUS ASTARTES.
TARGET: That friendly unit.
EFFECT: Attacks against it have -1 AP until attacker finishes.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Kraken Rounds
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when KILL TEAM unit shoots.
TARGET: That KILL TEAM.
EFFECT: Ranged attacks gain +6 inches Range and +1 Strength.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Hellfire Rounds
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when KILL TEAM shoots.
TARGET: That KILL TEAM.
EFFECT: Non-[DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ranged attacks gain [ANTI-non-VEHICLE 4+].

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Dragonfire Rounds
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when KILL TEAM shoots.
TARGET: That KILL TEAM.
EFFECT: Ranged attacks re-roll Wound rolls of 1 and gain [IGNORES COVER].

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Adaptive Tactics
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
EFFECT: Select one Combat Doctrine to be active through next Command phase.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Site-to-site Teleportation
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: End of opponent's Fight phase.
TARGET: One unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
EFFECT: Place in Strategic Reserves; if KILL TEAM, gain Deep Strike through next Movement phase.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Layered Ceramite
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE suffers a mortal wound.
TARGET: That VEHICLE unit.
EFFECT: It gains Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Might of the Machine Spirit
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE excluding DEDICATED TRANSPORT, FLY, and WALKER.
EFFECT: Until your next Command phase, ignore modifiers to Move, BS, Hit rolls, and Wound rolls.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Headhunter Doctrine
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when an ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE excluding DEDICATED TRANSPORT, FLY, and WALKER shoots.
TARGET: That VEHICLE unit.
EFFECT: Its ranged attacks gain [LETHAL HITS: MONSTER/VEHICLE].

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Wind-swift Evasion
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: End of Fight phase.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit eligible to fight this phase.
EFFECT: If unengaged, make a Normal move; if engaged, make a Fall Back move.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Sudden Onslaught
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when an ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED or SPEEDER unit Advances.
TARGET: That friendly unit.
EFFECT: Change its Advance roll to 6.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Hurtling Targets
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy targets an ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED or SPEEDER unit.
TARGET: That friendly unit.
EFFECT: Ranged attacks against it have -1 to Hit rolls.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Duty Unto Death
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when enemy targets a DEATHWING unit.
TARGET: That friendly DEATHWING unit.
EFFECT: Each model destroyed before fighting stays on a D6 roll of 4+, +1 if engaged with enemy near vowed objective; remove after fighting or phase ends.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Relic Teleportarium
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when DEATHWING with Deep Strike is selected for Ingress.
TARGET: That DEATHWING unit.
EFFECT: Set up more than 6 inches from enemies instead of 8; cannot charge this turn.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Wrath of the Lion
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when DEATHWING finishes charging.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Select engaged enemy; roll D6 per model engaging it. Every 3+ deals one mortal wound, maximum six.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Armour of Vengeance
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
COST: 1 CP; 2 CP when the enhanced effect is used
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects its targets.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit selected as a target of that enemy unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen that attack's AP by 1. Enhanced (2 CP): If your unit is DEATHWING and Steel-Warder is active for it (Ironskin Imperative, within 6" of an objective marker), worsen AP by 2 instead.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Deathwing Teleportarium
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
COST: 1 CP; 2 CP when the enhanced effect is used
WHEN: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
TARGET: Up to two friendly DEATHWING units, or one other friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit, that are not within Engagement Range of enemy units.
EFFECT: Remove the selected unit(s) from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves. Until the end of your next Movement phase, models in those units without Deep Strike gain Deep Strike. Enhanced (2 CP): When setting them up using Deep Strike, they may be set up more than 6" horizontally away from enemy units.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Blades of Caliban
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
COST: 1 CP; 2 CP when the enhanced effect is used
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.
TARGET: That friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, you can re-roll a Wound roll of 1. Enhanced (2 CP): If your unit is DEATHWING and Destroyer is active for it (Breaker Imperative, within 6" of an objective marker), also improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of its melee weapons by 1, add 1 to their Attacks characteristic and improve their AP by 1.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Maximux Protocol
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
COST: 1 CP; 2 CP when the enhanced effect is used
WHEN: Your Command phase or your opponent's Command phase.
TARGET: Your WARLORD unit.
EFFECT: In your opponent's Command phase, change the active Rhino Imperative to the other Imperative. Enhanced (2 CP): If used in your Command phase, both Rhino Imperatives are active until the start of your next Command phase instead of choosing one.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Undying Shield
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
COST: 1 CP; 2 CP when the enhanced effect is used
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects its targets.
TARGET: One friendly DEATHWING unit selected as a target of that enemy unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have Feel No Pain 5+; if that unit is within 6" of an objective marker, Feel No Pain 4+ instead. Enhanced (2 CP): If Steel-Warder is active for the unit (Ironskin Imperative, within 6" of an objective marker), models destroyed by that enemy unit's attacks can shoot or fight back before being removed; those attacks can only target that enemy unit.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Wrath of the Lion
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
COST: 1 CP; 2 CP when the enhanced effect is used
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly DEATHWING unit is selected to fight.
TARGET: That friendly DEATHWING unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, select [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1]; melee weapons equipped by models in your unit gain that ability. If your unit is within 6" of an objective marker, unmodified Hit rolls of 5+ score Critical Hits. Enhanced (2 CP): If Destroyer is active for your unit (Breaker Imperative, within 6" of an objective marker), those weapons gain both abilities instead.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Champion's Guidance
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER fights.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Melee attacks can re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Heroic Resolve
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, when an enemy targets ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Attacks against it have -1 Damage until enemy finishes.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Birth of a Saga
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit excluding MONSTER or VEHICLE.
EFFECT: It gains CHARACTER until next Command phase.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Focused Fury
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when ADEPTUS ASTARTES fight.
TARGET: That friendly unit.
EFFECT: Melee attacks gain [LETHAL HITS], plus [LANCE] if CHARACTER.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Strike Now for Glory
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when ADEPTUS ASTARTES attack.
TARGET: That friendly unit.
EFFECT: Ranged attacks gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Instant of Grace
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
EFFECT: It gains CHARACTER until your next Command phase.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Measured Strategist
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit.
EFFECT: Select a Combat Doctrine to become active until next Command phase.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Unto the Burning Skies
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: End of opponent's Fight phase.
TARGET: One unengaged friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK unit or THE SANGUINOR.
EFFECT: Place into Strategic Reserves.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: In the Shadow of Great Wings
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting phase, when enemy targets an ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER.
TARGET: That friendly unit.
EFFECT: It gains STEALTH and -3 inches detection range.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: In Sacrifice, Victory
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Any phase, when DEATHWING or RAVENWING unit controlling objective is destroyed.
TARGET: That destroyed unit.
EFFECT: Secure an objective it controlled at previous phase end, provided no enemy non-AIRCRAFT units are within range.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Lion's Will
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Command phase.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit within objective range.
EFFECT: +1 OC until end of turn.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Inescapable Justice
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES fight.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Its melee attacks gain [PRECISION].

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Tactical Mastery
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.
TARGET: One friendly DEATHWING or RAVENWING unit.
EFFECT: Select a Combat Doctrine active until next Command phase.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Knights of Iron
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Movement or Charge phase, when a RAVENWING unit moves or charges.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Gain MOBILE.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Relics of the Dark Age
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY or MOUNTED shoots.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Ranged attacks gain +2 Strength.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Unbridled Ferocity
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when BLOOD CLAWS, THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY or WULFEN fight.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Melee attacks gain [LANCE].

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Co-ordinated Strike
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: End of opponent's Fight phase.
TARGET: One unengaged BLOOD CLAWS, THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY or WULFEN within 9 inches of an edge.
EFFECT: Place in Strategic Reserves.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Impetuosity
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting phase, after enemy shoots unengaged BLOOD CLAWS, THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY or WULFEN.
TARGET: That friendly unit.
EFFECT: Make a surge move up to D6 inches.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Blazing Earth
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Start of opponent's Charge phase.
TARGET: One unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit with Torrent or Melta weapons.
EFFECT: Choose a visible enemy within 12 inches; it suffers -1 to Charge rolls.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Wrath and Ruin
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
EFFECT: Assault or Tactical Doctrine becomes active until your next Command phase.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Forged in Fire
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when an engaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit shoots.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Torrent weapons lose [BLAST], gain [CLOSE-QUARTERS], and +1 Attacks.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Immolation Protocols
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY attack.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Its ranged [TORRENT] attacks gain +1 AP.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Crucible of Battle
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting or Fight phase, when ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY attack a unit within 6 inches.
TARGET: That INFANTRY unit.
EFFECT: Re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Burning Vengeance
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy shoots a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked in that TRANSPORT.
EFFECT: Disembark, then shoot normally targeting only the attacking enemy.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Into Darkness
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: End of opponent's Fight phase.
TARGET: One unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
EFFECT: Place into Strategic Reserves.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Raptorial Vigilance
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Movement phase, when enemy moves within 8 inches of an unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Normal move up to D6 inches, or up to 6 inches if PHOBOS or SCOUT SQUAD.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Murderous Fusillade
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when an ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit that made Ingress this turn shoots.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Its ranged attacks gain +1 BS and +1 AP.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Suppressed Weapons
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, after ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY shoots.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Its attacks do not prevent it from being hidden.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Feint and Thrust
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
EFFECT: Tactical Doctrine is active in addition to other doctrines until next Command phase.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Lay Low the Tyrants
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY fights.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Melee attacks gain [PRECISION].

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Evasive Manoeuvres
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy targets an ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED or SPEEDER unit.
TARGET: That friendly unit.
EFFECT: Ranged attacks targeting the unit have -1 to Wound rolls.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Mobile Lethality
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when ADEPTUS ASTARTES Advance or Fall Back.
TARGET: That friendly unit.
EFFECT: Falling Back does not prevent Shooting; ranged attacks gain [ASSAULT].

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Flawless Riders
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Movement or Charge phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit moves or charges.
TARGET: That MOUNTED unit.
EFFECT: It gains MOBILE.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Spear Thrust and Sabre Swing
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when ADEPTUS ASTARTES fight.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Melee attacks gain [LETHAL HITS] or [LANCE], or both if MOUNTED.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Withdraw and Regroup
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: End of opponent's Fight phase.
TARGET: One unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED or SPEEDER unit.
EFFECT: Place it into Strategic Reserves.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Hunter's Instincts
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy finishes moving within 8 inches of an unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY, MOUNTED or SPEEDER.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Make a Normal move up to D3+3 inches.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Armour of Contempt
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, when an enemy targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Attacks against it have -1 AP until the attacker finishes.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Exemplary Vigilance
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when ADEPTUS ASTARTES are selected to shoot.
TARGET: That friendly unit.
EFFECT: Its ranged attacks gain [IGNORES COVER].

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Ultramarian Adaptivity
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
EFFECT: Select a Combat Doctrine. It is active for the unit until your next Command phase.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Courage and Honour!
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit fights.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Its melee attacks gain [LANCE].

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Practical Tactics
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Movement phase, after enemy ends a move within 8 inches of unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY or MOUNTED.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: It can make a Normal move up to D3+3 inches.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Tactical Foresight
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, when an enemy targets ADEPTUS ASTARTES.
TARGET: That friendly unit.
EFFECT: Attacks of greater Strength than the unit's Toughness have -1 to Wound rolls.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Eye of the Pack
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting or Fight phase, when ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY attack.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Re-roll Wound rolls of 1 and 2.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Wolf Totems
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Any phase, when ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY or MOUNTED suffers a mortal wound.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Fangs of the Pack
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY or MOUNTED fights.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Melee attacks gain [PRECISION].

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Fenrisian Ferocity
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Movement or Charge phase, when ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED or WALKER moves or charges.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Gain MOBILE.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Grimnar's Command
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit excluding MONSTER or VEHICLE.
EFFECT: Select a Combat Doctrine active until next Command phase.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Battle Instincts
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting phase, after enemy shoots an unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY or MOUNTED.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Normal move up to D3+3 inches.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Unyielding Might
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Command phase.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit on an objective.
EFFECT: +1 OC until end of turn.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Stand to the End
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, when an enemy targets ADEPTUS ASTARTES other than MONSTER or VEHICLE.
TARGET: That friendly unit.
EFFECT: Attacks with Strength greater than Toughness suffer -1 Wound, or all attacks suffer -1 Wound if entrenched.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Augmented Targeting
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting or Fight phase, when ADEPTUS ASTARTES attack.
TARGET: That friendly unit.
EFFECT: Choose [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1]; if entrenched, gain both.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Establish Supremacy
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when entrenched ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY consolidate.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Use objective consolidation mode despite Before Moving restrictions.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Priority Strike
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting or Fight phase, when ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY or MOUNTED attack.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: +1 Wound rolls against MONSTER or VEHICLE.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Evasive Repositioning
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting phase, just after enemy attacks wound an unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY or MOUNTED unit.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Move up to D6 inches, or D3+3 inches if entrenched; cannot embark this turn.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Slayers of Abominations
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD fights.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Melee attacks against MONSTERS or VEHICLES gain +2 Strength.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Unsparing Execution
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy engaged with SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD Falls Back.
TARGET: That friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD.
EFFECT: The enemy must use Desperate Escape, with -1 to hazard rolls if Battle-shocked.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Blade of Detestation
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD finishes charging.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Select engaged enemy; roll one D6 per engaged model. Each 4+ deals one mortal wound, up to six.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Judgement of the Golden Host
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when SANGUINARY GUARD finish charging.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Select an engaged enemy; roll D6 for each model engaged with it. Every 3+ causes one mortal wound.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Inexorable Valour
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Movement phase, when enemy Falls Back from SANGUINARY GUARD and leaves them unengaged.
TARGET: That SANGUINARY GUARD.
EFFECT: Make a Normal move of up to D3+3 inches.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Blinding Blurs of Vengeance
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting phase, when enemy targets SANGUINARY GUARD.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: It gains STEALTH and -3 inches detection range.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Death Begets Vengeance
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Any phase, when an enemy destroys a DEATH COMPANY unit.
TARGET: That enemy unit.
EFFECT: It becomes hated for battle; DEATH COMPANY attacks targeting it gain +1 to Wound rolls.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: No Barrier to Retribution
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Movement or Charge phase, when DEATH COMPANY DREADNOUGHT makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: It gains MOBILE.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Rage-fuelled Response
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting phase, after enemy shoots an unengaged DEATH COMPANY unit.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Make a surge move of up to D6 inches.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Skyborne Surveillance
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, after RAVENWING FLY shoots.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Visible enemies within 6 inches gain +3 inches detection range.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: We Are Vengeance
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting phase, after enemy shoots an unengaged RAVENWING FLY unit.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Make a Normal move of up to D3+3 inches.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Wings of Shadow
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting phase, when enemy targets RAVENWING FLY or MOUNTED.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: It gains STEALTH.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Armour of Contempt
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting phase or Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
EFFECT: Attacks targeting your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Gene-wrought Might
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
EFFECT: Its melee attacks have [LANCE]. If the Assault Doctrine is active, those attacks also have +1 AP.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Duty in Death
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
EFFECT: When one of its models is destroyed before it fights, roll a D6 (+1 if the Assault Doctrine is active). On 4+, do not remove the model until the unit has fought or the phase ends.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Armour of Contempt
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting phase or Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
EFFECT: Attacks targeting your unit have -1 AP until the attacking unit has attacked.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Domination Fire
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, after a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit has shot.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
EFFECT: Select an enemy unit hit by its attacks. That enemy unit is suppressed until the start of your next turn; suppressed units have -1 to Hit rolls.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Masterful Tactics
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8 inches of an unengaged friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY or MOUNTED unit.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
EFFECT: Make a Normal move up to D6 inches, or up to 6 inches if the Tactical Doctrine is active.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Armour of Contempt
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, when an enemy targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Attacks targeting it have -1 AP until the attacking unit has attacked.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Storm of Fire
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Its ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER]; if Devastator Doctrine is active, they also have +1 AP.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Hail of Vengeance
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy shoots and destroys a model in a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
TARGET: That friendly unit.
EFFECT: Shoot normally, targeting only the enemy unit that just attacked.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Tactical Dreadnought Fortitude
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, when an enemy targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Attacks targeting it have -1 Damage until that enemy has attacked.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Merciless Veterans
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Its ranged attacks have [LETHAL HITS] and [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Gunship Extraction
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: End of opponent's Fight phase.
TARGET: One unengaged friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.
EFFECT: Place that unit in Strategic Reserves.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Relentless Assault
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or Fight phase, when a friendly TACTICUS unit attacks.
TARGET: That TACTICUS unit.
EFFECT: Its attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE] or [LETHAL HITS: MONSTER/VEHICLE].

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Transhuman Swiftness
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit fights.
TARGET: One friendly TACTICUS unit within range of an objective and eligible to fight.
EFFECT: That unit has Fights First and must be selected to fight next.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Tactical Focus
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly TACTICUS unit is selected to consolidate.
TARGET: That TACTICUS unit.
EFFECT: That unit can consolidate up to D3+3 inches.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: For the Emperor!
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Command phase.
TARGET: One friendly TACTICUS unit within range of an objective.
EFFECT: That unit has +1 OC until end of turn.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Relentless Assault
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or Fight phase, when a friendly TACTICUS unit attacks.
TARGET: That TACTICUS unit.
EFFECT: Its attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE] or [LETHAL HITS: MONSTER/VEHICLE].

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Point-blank Brutality
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly engaged TACTICUS unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: That TACTICUS unit.
EFFECT: Its non-[BLAST] ranged attacks gain [CLOSE-QUARTERS] and [IGNORES COVER].

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Strike from the Shadows
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting or Fight phase, when a friendly hidden PHOBOS unit attacks.
TARGET: That PHOBOS unit.
EFFECT: Its attacks have +1 Strength and [LETHAL HITS].

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Mortis Snares
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.
TARGET: One unengaged friendly PHOBOS or SCOUT SQUAD unit.
EFFECT: If it controls an objective, that objective becomes snared. The next enemy ending a move in range suffers D6 mortal wounds on a 2+, then remove the snare.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Tactical Withdrawal
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: End of opponent's Fight phase.
TARGET: One unengaged friendly PHOBOS or SCOUT SQUAD unit.
EFFECT: Place that unit into Strategic Reserves.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Strike from the Shadows
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting or Fight phase, when a friendly hidden PHOBOS unit attacks.
TARGET: That PHOBOS unit.
EFFECT: Its attacks have +1 Strength and [LETHAL HITS].

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Transhuman Reactions
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy finishes a move within 8 inches of an unengaged friendly PHOBOS unit.
TARGET: That PHOBOS unit.
EFFECT: Make a Normal move of up to D6 inches, or up to 6 inches if Tactical Doctrine is active.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Umbral Evasion
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy targets a friendly PHOBOS unit.
TARGET: That PHOBOS unit.
EFFECT: Ranged attacks targeting that unit have -1 to Hit rolls.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Annihilating Force
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting or Fight phase, when a GRAVIS unit is selected to attack.
TARGET: That friendly GRAVIS unit.
EFFECT: Its attacks gain [LETHAL HITS].

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Purgation Push
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, just after a GRAVIS unit shoots.
TARGET: That friendly GRAVIS unit.
EFFECT: If unengaged, move normally up to 5 inches, ending within range of an objective. Cannot charge or embark this turn.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Armoured Impact
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, after a GRAVIS unit finishes charging.
TARGET: That GRAVIS unit.
EFFECT: Select an engaged enemy. Roll a D6 for every model in your unit engaged with it; each 3+ inflicts one mortal wound.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Annihilating Force
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting or Fight phase, when a GRAVIS unit is selected to attack.
TARGET: That friendly GRAVIS unit.
EFFECT: Its attacks gain [LETHAL HITS].

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Stand Unyielding
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.
TARGET: One friendly GRAVIS unit.
EFFECT: Secure an objective controlled by the unit.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Suppression Volleys
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, just after a GRAVIS unit shoots.
TARGET: That friendly GRAVIS unit.
EFFECT: Select an enemy hit by its attacks; the enemy takes a Battle-shock roll at -1.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Adamantine Terror
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Start of Fight phase.
TARGET: One friendly DREADNOUGHT unit.
EFFECT: Every enemy engaged with it makes a Battle-shock roll at -1.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Mercy Is Weakness
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting or Fight phase, when a friendly DREADNOUGHT unit attacks.
TARGET: That DREADNOUGHT unit.
EFFECT: Its attacks gain either [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Unstoppable Advance
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Movement or Charge phase, when a friendly DREADNOUGHT moves or charges.
TARGET: That DREADNOUGHT unit.
EFFECT: That unit has MOBILE.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Aggressive Disembarkation
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Any phase, when an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked in a TRANSPORT is selected to move.
TARGET: That friendly embarked unit.
EFFECT: Models can be set up within the TRANSPORT's set-up distance, rather than wholly within it.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Duty Is Never Done
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: End of Fight phase.
TARGET: One unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit eligible to fight this phase, wholly within 6 inches of an eligible friendly TRANSPORT.
EFFECT: Embark within that TRANSPORT.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Storm and Secure
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT with an embarked ADEPTUS ASTARTES BATTLELINE unit.
EFFECT: Secure one objective controlled by the TRANSPORT.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Doctrinal Flexibility
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.
TARGET: One friendly CRUSADER SQUAD.
EFFECT: Select a Combat Doctrine; it is active until next Command phase.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Angels Defiant
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, when an enemy targets a CRUSADER SQUAD.
TARGET: That friendly unit.
EFFECT: Attacks with Strength higher than this unit's Toughness have -1 Wound rolls.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Avowed Destruction
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD fights.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Its melee attacks gain either [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Dread Crusaders
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Charge phase, when enemy selects charge targets.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY targeted by the charge.
EFFECT: Enemy makes a Battle-shock roll at -1.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: For the Emperor's Honour!
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY fights.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Melee attacks gain [PRECISION].

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Heresy Begets Retribution
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Movement phase, after enemy moves within 8 inches of ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Surge move up to D6 inches.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Spoor of the Unholy
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting or Fight phase, when ADEPTUS ASTARTES attack.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Ignore modifiers to WS, BS and Hit rolls.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Pious Enmity
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when friendly CHAPLAIN or JUDICIAR fights.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Melee attacks re-roll Hit rolls of 1, or against MONSTER or VEHICLE re-roll Hit and Wound rolls of 1.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Devout Push
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY pile in or consolidate.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Move up to D3+3 inches during that Pile In or Consolidation.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Methodical Brutality
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting or Fight phase, when an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit attacks.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1]; VEHICLE units additionally receive +1 to Wound rolls.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Spirits of Iron
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Any phase, when friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES suffer a mortal wound.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Vengeful Animus
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Any phase, when friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE is destroyed before Deadly Demise.
TARGET: That VEHICLE.
EFFECT: Change Deadly Demise rolls to unmodified 6.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Ancient Fury
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES DREADNOUGHT.
EFFECT: Until next Command phase, +1 Move, Toughness, Leadership, Objective Control and Hit rolls.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Unbowed Conviction
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.
TARGET: One friendly below-starting-strength ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
EFFECT: Until next Command phase, ignore modifiers to WS, BS, Hit and Wound rolls.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Power of the Machine Spirit
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy shoots an unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE.
TARGET: That friendly VEHICLE.
EFFECT: Return fire at that enemy using Snap Shooting, or normal Shooting if at or below half-strength.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Kraken Rounds
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when KILL TEAM shoots.
TARGET: That KILL TEAM.
EFFECT: Ranged attacks gain +6 inches Range and +1 Strength.

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Dragonfire Rounds
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when KILL TEAM shoots.
TARGET: That KILL TEAM.
EFFECT: Ranged attacks re-roll Wound rolls of 1 and gain [IGNORES COVER].

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Hellfire Rounds
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when KILL TEAM shoots.
TARGET: That KILL TEAM.
EFFECT: Non-[DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ranged attacks gain [ANTI-non-VEHICLE 4+].

Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.name: Blackstar Extraction
Imperium - Adeptus Astartes - Space Mari.description:
WHEN: End of opponent's Fight phase.
TARGET: One unengaged KILL TEAM unit.
EFFECT: Place in Strategic Reserves.

Xenos - Necrons.name: Protocol of the Eternal Revenant
Xenos - Necrons.description:
WHEN: Any phase, just after a friendly NECRONS INFANTRY CHARACTER model is destroyed.
TARGET: That destroyed model.
EFFECT: At the end of the phase, set up that model unengaged as close as possible to where it was destroyed, with half its Starting Wounds remaining. It is no longer part of an Attached unit and its unit has a Starting Strength of 1. RESTRICTION: Once per battle per model.

Xenos - Necrons.name: Protocol of the Conquering Tyrant
Xenos - Necrons.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly NECRONS unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, when models in that unit make ranged attacks against a target within half range, re-roll Hit rolls of 1. If a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading that unit, re-roll Hit rolls instead.

Xenos - Necrons.name: Protocol of the Undying Legions
Xenos - Necrons.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit resolves its attacks.
TARGET: One friendly NECRONS unit that had at least one model destroyed by those attacks.
EFFECT: That unit activates Reanimation Protocols and reanimates D3 wounds, or D3+1 if it is led by a NECRONS CHARACTER.

Xenos - Orks.name: Breakin' Heads
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly Attached ORKS INFANTRY unit becomes Battle-shocked.
TARGET: That unit, even though it is Battle-shocked.
EFFECT: Roll one D3. Your unit suffers that many mortal wounds and is no longer Battle-shocked.

Xenos - Orks.name: Hit 'Em Harder
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to fight.
TARGET: That ORKS unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, melee attacks made by your unit have [LETHAL HITS].

Xenos - Orks.name: Orks Is Never Beaten
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS unit (excluding TITANIC units).
TARGET: That ORKS unit.
EFFECT: If a model is destroyed before your unit fights, roll one D6 (+1 if the unit is riled up). On a 4+, leave that model in play until the unit fights or the phase ends, then remove it.

Xenos - Orks.name: Mow 'Em Down
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS VEHICLE unit (excluding WALKERS) that charged this turn is selected to fight.
TARGET: That ORKS VEHICLE unit.
EFFECT: Its melee attacks gain [CLEAVE 1], or increase their existing [CLEAVE] value by 1.

Xenos - Orks.name: Fungus-fuel Injection
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ORKS MOUNTED or VEHICLE unit is selected to move.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.

Xenos - Orks.name: Close-range Dakka
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: That ORKS unit.
EFFECT: Its ranged attacks gain [RAPID FIRE 1], or increase their existing [RAPID FIRE] value by 1.

Xenos - Orks.name: Where D'Ya Fink You're Going?
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy engaged with BEAST SNAGGA units is selected to Fall Back.
TARGET: One engaged friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit.
EFFECT: The enemy must use Desperate Escape. MONSTER or VEHICLE units make three extra hazard rolls for each BEAST SNAGGA unit engaging them; subtract 1 from those rolls if Battle-shocked.

Xenos - Orks.name: Goaded Into Action
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit has shot.
TARGET: One unengaged friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit that lost a wound from those attacks.
EFFECT: Make a surge move of up to D6 inches, re-rolling the D6 if riled up.

Xenos - Orks.name: Instinctive Hunters
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: End of opponent's Fight phase.
TARGET: One unengaged friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit within 6 inches of a battlefield edge.
EFFECT: Place the unit into Strategic Reserves.

Xenos - Orks.name: Crazed Rampage
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS WALKER unit (excluding TITANIC units).
TARGET: That ORKS WALKER unit.
EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, adding 3 if your unit has DEFF DREAD. On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. Remove it when your unit has fought or at the end of the phase, whichever comes first.

Xenos - Orks.name: Dread Power
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.
TARGET: One friendly ORKS WALKER unit.
EFFECT: Your unit is riled up until the start of your next turn.

Xenos - Orks.name: Stomping Juggernaut
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Your Movement or Charge phase, when a friendly ORKS WALKER unit is selected to move or declares a charge.
TARGET: That ORKS WALKER unit.
EFFECT: Your unit has MOBILE.

Xenos - Orks.name: Unbridled Carnage
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a BOYZ unit that charged is selected to fight.
TARGET: That BOYZ unit.
EFFECT: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons until the end of the phase.

Xenos - Orks.name: Mob Mentality
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Start of the Battle-shock step of your Command phase.
TARGET: One friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit with 13 or more models.
EFFECT: One visible friendly ORKS unit within 12 inches automatically passes Battle-shock rolls this step.

Xenos - Orks.name: 'Ere We Go
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly BOYZ or BEAST SNAGGA BOYZ unit is selected to move.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Add 2 to Advance rolls made for that unit.

Xenos - Orks.name: Too Arrogant to Die
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets friendly NOBZ or MEGANOBZ.
TARGET: That NOBZ or MEGANOBZ unit.
EFFECT: For each destroyed model before this unit fights, roll a D6 (+1 if riled up). On a 4+, the model remains until it fights or the phase ends, then is removed.

Xenos - Orks.name: Armed to Da Teef
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when friendly NOBZ or MEGANOBZ are selected to attack.
TARGET: That NOBZ or MEGANOBZ unit.
EFFECT: Re-roll Hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by that unit; if riled up, re-roll all Hit rolls instead.

Xenos - Orks.name: Hulking Brutes
Xenos - Orks.description:
COST: 1 CP / 2 CP
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting phase, when a friendly NOBZ or MEGANOBZ unit is targeted.
TARGET: That NOBZ or MEGANOBZ unit.
EFFECT: For 1 CP, subtract 1 from Wound rolls for ranged attacks with Strength greater than this unit's Toughness. For 2 CP, subtract 1 from Wound rolls for all ranged attacks targeting this unit.

Xenos - Orks.name: Delicious Eating Squigs
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.
TARGET: One friendly RUKKATRUKK SQUIGBUGGIES unit.
EFFECT: Choose any number of friendly ORKS INFANTRY units within 3 inches of it; each heals 3 wounds.

Xenos - Orks.name: Dakkastorm
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit shoots.
TARGET: That SPEED FREEKS unit.
EFFECT: Its ranged attacks gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

Xenos - Orks.name: Speediest Freeks
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy targets a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit.
TARGET: That SPEED FREEKS unit.
EFFECT: Ranged attacks against it fail on unmodified Hit rolls of 1-3.

Xenos - Orks.name: Dubious Restraint
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Start or end of your Movement phase.
TARGET: One friendly BOYZ, KOMMANDOS, or STORMBOYZ unit.
EFFECT: Secure one objective that unit controls.

Xenos - Orks.name: Mind Mostly on the Mission
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when an eligible BOYZ, KOMMANDOS, or STORMBOYZ unit Advances or Falls Back.
TARGET: That friendly unit.
EFFECT: This move does not stop the unit from starting an action.

Xenos - Orks.name: While Their Backs Are Turned
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: End of opponent's Movement phase.
TARGET: One unengaged BOYZ, KOMMANDOS, or STORMBOYZ unit that was engaged at the start of the phase.
EFFECT: The unit makes a Normal move up to 6 inches.

Xenos - Orks.name: Pile Through
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit opens a Hatchway.
TARGET: That ORKS unit.
EFFECT: The unit gains Fights First until the end of the turn.

Xenos - Orks.name: Ramboyz Rampage
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.
TARGET: One BOYZ unit not yet selected to move.
EFFECT: This turn the unit can charge after Advancing. Its Advance adds 6 inches to Move rather than rolling.

Xenos - Orks.name: Eager to Fight
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, in the Reinforcements step, just after a friendly ORKS unit is set up in an Entry Zone.
TARGET: That ORKS unit.
EFFECT: Your unit can make an Advance move.

Xenos - Orks.name: Enraged Rush
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
TARGET: One friendly BOYZ unit that was targeted by one or more of that enemy unit's attacks.
EFFECT: Your unit can make an Enraged Rush move. Roll one D6; models in your unit can move up to that many inches, but must end as close as possible to the attacking unit. They can move within Engagement Range of that enemy unit, but not of other enemy units.

Xenos - Orks.name: Loot on the Move
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit opens a Hatchway.
TARGET: That ORKS unit.
EFFECT: The Hatchway cannot be closed for the rest of the battle. Worsen AP of attacks against this unit by 1 until end of turn.

Xenos - Orks.name: Pile Through
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit opens a Hatchway.
TARGET: That ORKS unit.
EFFECT: The unit gains Fights First until end of turn.

Xenos - Orks.name: Pit Fighter
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Your Charge phase.
TARGET: One friendly WARBOSS model.
EFFECT: The model can charge despite having Fallen Back this turn.

Xenos - Orks.name: Cornered and Krumped
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Movement phase, immediately after an enemy unit is selected to Fall Back.
TARGET: One ORKS unit engaged with that enemy.
EFFECT: Fight against that enemy as in the Fight phase; only unmodified Hit rolls of 6 score hits.

Xenos - Orks.name: Keep It Runnin'
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: End of Fight phase.
TARGET: One unengaged ORKS INFANTRY unit eligible to fight this phase and wholly within 6 inches of an eligible friendly TRANSPORT.
EFFECT: That INFANTRY unit embarks in the TRANSPORT.

Xenos - Orks.name: Readied Brawlers
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a friendly WAGON completes a Normal move.
TARGET: That WAGON.
EFFECT: Units embarked in the WAGON can make an Assault Disembark move.

Xenos - Orks.name: Impending Krunch
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, after a friendly WAGON finishes a Charge move.
TARGET: That WAGON.
EFFECT: Enemy units engaged with it make a Battle-shock roll, subtracting 1 from the roll.

Xenos - Orks.name: Infested War Zone
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Any phase, just after an enemy unit has attacked.
TARGET: A friendly GRETCHIN unit just destroyed.
EFFECT: Add an identical full-strength GRETCHIN unit to Strategic Reserves, even though the targeted unit was destroyed.

Xenos - Orks.name: Scarper!
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Movement phase, after an enemy ends a move within 8 inches of unengaged GRETCHIN.
TARGET: That friendly GRETCHIN unit.
EFFECT: Make a Normal move of up to D6 inches, or up to 6 inches if Attached.

Xenos - Orks.name: Grot Shields
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy targets friendly non-GRETCHIN ORKS INFANTRY.
TARGET: A GRETCHIN unit within 3 inches of the target.
EFFECT: Each successful hit instead ends its attack sequence and inflicts 1 mortal wound on the GRETCHIN unit, if it has models remaining.

Xenos - Orks.name: Kustom Dakka
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when ORKS INFANTRY are selected to shoot.
TARGET: That friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit.
EFFECT: Add 1 to Wound rolls against units other than MONSTERS and VEHICLES.

Xenos - Orks.name: Glowin' Dakka
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when ORKS INFANTRY are selected to shoot.
TARGET: That friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit.
EFFECT: Improve ranged Armour Penetration by 1 against units within 9 inches.

Xenos - Orks.name: Never Enough Dakka
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when ORKS INFANTRY are selected to shoot.
TARGET: That friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit.
EFFECT: Ranged attacks gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1] until the end of the phase.

Xenos - Orks.name: Drive-by Bustin'
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when an ORKS TRANSPORT shoots.
TARGET: That friendly ORKS TRANSPORT.
EFFECT: Add 1 to Hit rolls with ranged weapons selected through Firing Deck.

Xenos - Orks.name: Grab It
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, after an unengaged BREAKA BOYZ, FLASH GITZ, or TANKBUSTAS unit shoots.
TARGET: That friendly unit.
EFFECT: Make a Normal move up to 6 inches, ending within range of an objective. The unit cannot charge this turn.

Xenos - Orks.name: Gun-crazy Show-offs
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit shoots.
TARGET: One friendly FLASH GITZ or TANKBUSTAS unit hit by its attacks.
EFFECT: Shoot normally, but only targeting that enemy unit.

Xenos - Orks.name: Flyin' Headbutt
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT unit is destroyed, before Deadly Demise.
TARGET: That destroyed ORKS AIRCRAFT.
EFFECT: Ignore Deadly Demise. Choose an enemy unit within 12 inches and roll eight D6; each 4+ inflicts 1 mortal wound. Remove the aircraft.

Xenos - Orks.name: Long, Uncontrolled Bursts
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT or DEFFKOPTAS unit shoots.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Ranged attacks against FLY units can re-roll Hit rolls.

Xenos - Orks.name: Whirligig Evasion
Xenos - Orks.description:
WHEN: Opponent's Movement phase, after an enemy unit completes a move.
TARGET: One unengaged DEFFKOPTAS unit within 8 inches of that enemy.
EFFECT: Make a Normal move up to D6 inches, or up to 6 inches if riled up.
